description: Lessons topics. Regions first (exam questions and reading by body region), then whole-skeleton topics that only the textbook has. 'regions' are bone regions (content/bones). Textbook sections name their topic in content/textbook/index.json.

topics.title: Thorax

topics.title: Upper limb
topics.blurb: Pectoral girdle, humerus, radius and ulna, and the bones of the hand

topics.title: Lower limb
topics.blurb: Femur, patella, tibia and fibula, and the bones of the foot

topics.title: Pelvis

topics.title: Bone tissue
topics.blurb: What bone does, how it is built, grows, heals and is kept in balance

topics.title: Joints
